decided_by: Alexander Kell (architect), AD-290; delegated to the manager 2026-11-03
rationale: AD-290 adds archkeel.cli.launcher, which holds the state file, the reuse and the stop of a running Studio. It adds archkeel.studio.server:is_studio to the public interface of server and studio and to the interface through which cli requires studio, and archkeel.cli.launcher to the exact modules of composition. The server responsibility also names the idle end and the identity check. validate --against origin/main measures calls_unresolved 844 before and 854 after, net +10: 6 new unresolved calls in archkeel.cli (the launcher, the signal handlers and the new studio options) and 4 in archkeel.studio (the idle end and the identity request, stdlib receivers).
